args: Double-click on Enter Settlement (74,476) outside town: first click entered, second landed on Withdraw Funds which took Enter's slot inside town. Status: 'Withdrew 9 coins from settlement' (coins 339->348) at tick 1703. Exit Settlement is the 3rd button on that row inside, not in Enter's slot.

In own town, hovering Buy Axe (312) at (65,414) with no pawn in reach; Victor Taylor walked within 3.2m and the pawn rows inserted below the Craft group, pushing Buy Axe/Buy Pickaxe up a row; Talk to Victor Taylor (Stranger) is now under the cursor (highlighted). Craft/Buy tool buttons come after People, so they move whenever a pawn enters/leaves reach. Screenshot shots/pawn_in_over_buy.png, tick ~2300.

MISCLICK WITH COST: hovered Talk to <pawn> at (65,414) in own town; the pawn walked out of reach and the Craft-group buttons dropped into the pawn row's slot; my click (tick 2463) bought a pickaxe: 'Bought 1 pickaxe for 299 coins from Frank Thompson' (coins 348->49). Intended Talk, got an unconfirmed 299-coin purchase. Screenshot shots/pawn_out_click.png

Same moment: Build House disappeared from the Place/Build row (settlement went 7->10 buildings, so no room) and Build Farm and Send Caravan slid left into its slot (Send Caravan moved from x~600 to x~450). Removing rather than disabling a Build button moves its neighbours.

Outside own town near a Fortressshire caravan (shots/afterhome.png, tick ~4595): rows were Place / Escort Caravan / Talk+Gift / Order+Craft Axe. When the caravan moved off (shots/dbl_craft.png, tick ~4700) the Trade row vanished and every row above it dropped one row: Talk 414->445, Order 383->414, Craft Axe (337,383)->(337,414). A click aimed at Talk lands on Order <pawn>: Gather Wood; my double-click on Craft Axe at (337,383) hit empty space. Rows stacking upward means any lower group disappearing moves all higher ones down.

Second Build button vanished: settlement reached 11 buildings and Build Farm was removed (not disabled); Send Caravan slid from x~450 to x~297 into its slot. Compare shots/town2.png (tick ~5300) and shots/feed_wait1.png (tick 6587).

Objective 7 'Reach the Village era' progress bar text is clipped on the left: shows 'pers 10/10 • Buildings 2/2' (start of 'Members' cut off). Also the Inventory Info box has moved from the left column to the middle of the screen (x~220,y~195) since entering town, overlapping the scene; I did not drag it.

Double-click on Exit Settlement (377,476) inside own town: first click exits, second lands on Plant Sapling, which occupies that slot outside. Sapling 2->1 and a tree sapling now stands in the middle of the town square next to the well (tick ~8540). No status message about planting appeared (only 'Exited settlement.'), so the player would not know why a tree is there. Screenshot shots/dbl_exit.png.

Inventory Info panel jumps between the left column (x~10) and the middle of the screen (x~220,y~195) depending on whether pawn rows are in the command bar: compare shots/feedpoll3.png (no pawn, left column) with shots/feedpoll5.png (pawn in reach, box in centre over the scene). Every pawn walking by makes this panel hop sideways.
